faq.q: Do I need to message before buying?
faq.a: No. Buy the service, then follow the intake instructions on the success page.
Stripe products are tagged using metadata so the site auto-sorts them.

faq.q: Can I buy from my phone?
faq.a: Yes. The layout is mobile-first and Stripe Checkout is mobile-ready.

faq.q: What if Stripe isn't connected yet?
faq.a: The site shows demo services so you can preview and deploy anytime.

footer.note: Secure checkout via Stripe. Mobile-first. Fast service flow.
